scope: Eight additional Moodlet icons; asset preparation only. UI mappings, Moodlet rules, wishes, horoscope props and character artwork unchanged.
reference_delivery: Descriptive prompts only; existing images were inspected locally for visual comparison, not supplied as edit targets.

icons.label: Doch verloren
icons.subject: A single soft powder-blue five-point game star with its upper point gently drooping and a mildly disappointed little face: two tiny navy eyes and a tiny downturned mouth. One tiny dusty-rose downward accent beside it. Convey a disappointed lost game, gentle sadness rather than boredom or exhaustion. No controller, trophy, tears or broken heart.
icons.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE individual original transparent PNG moodlet icon for Aiko's approved anime visual-novel/cozy JRPG desktop UI. Style: clean smooth 2D illustrated icon, rounded desaturated dark-navy outlines (around #243C67), powder blue #B8DDF2, blush pink #F2B3C5, warm cream #FFF1D0, restrained gentle shading and small pale highlights. Friendly pastel illustrated style, not pixel art, not 3D, not a glossy plastic app logo. Keep the contour confidently readable at 24–48 pixels. Square canvas, centered balanced silhouette, approximately 70 percent canvas occupancy with at least 12 percent clear padding on every side. Genuine transparent background including all open gaps. No background, tile, circular backing, sticker rim, drawn checkerboard, drop shadow, text, lettering, numerals, watermark, full character or UI screenshot. Generate ONLY the specified compact symbol.
